title: Distilling Knowledge from Search: Decoder Model Factory for Quantum LDPC Codes
summary: A local neural decoder learns from verified search trajectories, transferring across quantum LDPC decoding tasks and adapting to changed noise in simulation.

title: Opportunities and challenges in scaling quantum error detection on hardware
summary: Hardware experiments and noisy simulations map the promise and resource costs of quantum error detection, including sampling overhead and classical processing constraints.
